title: Multi-agent ownership
description: Make delegation bounded, non-overlapping, and independently reviewable.
purpose: Preserve clear authority and evidence when multiple workers contribute.
requirements: multi-agent-ownership/dispatch-purpose: Delegate only when the work benefits from separate context, expertise, or independent verification.
multi-agent-ownership/isolate-writers: Give each worker a bounded input, output, and authority contract; never assign overlapping writers.
multi-agent-ownership/preserve-coordination: Keep the coordinator responsible for scope, integration, and final disposition of worker results.
multi-agent-ownership/independent-evidence: Require independent evidence review for behavior, permissions, destructive actions, and release claims.
invariants: Delegate only when useful, isolate context and writes, prohibit overlapping writers, and require independent evidence review.
